title: Great Service
text:
We booked a Barcelona city tour with this company just a 1 hour before of starting tour. And company response was very quick and driver was available on time. Driver was very friendly communicator and he explained us about every point that we visited like Sagrada Familia, Casa Batllo, Tibidabo.Park Guell Etc. 
very recommended service
author: waltersD5749XL

title: Ok but not great
text: The driver was amazing. We were suppose to have an English speaking guide for Park Guelle we didn't get although I paid for his ticket. $900 euro was very expensive for 4 hour cab service with no guide. Again the driver was great but way to expensive for what we received.
author: Steve_K
